title: Determining Concentration from Raman Spectroscopy with Manifold Learning and Y-shaped Conformal Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.21196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monitoring of chemical processes is crucial in chemical engineering, motivating sophisticated process analytical technology (PAT). In-line analytics are advantageous, with Raman spectroscopy being an established and reliable tool in various applications, from which many properties can be determined. We recently [Koronaki et al., AIChEJ 2024] proposed determining polymer particle size from Raman spectroscopic data, by combining Diffusion Maps (a manifold learning method) with a Y-shaped Conformal Autoencoder Neural Network. Herein, we extend this workflow to predict liquid concentrations, allowing also for multiple target predictions from the same model. We apply the methods on two datasets consisting of Raman measurements and concentration measurements: one from microgel polymerization and one from citric acid dissociation. translated_title: 利用流形学习与Y形保形自编码器从拉曼光谱测定浓度
translated_abstract: 化学过程监测在化学工程中至关重要，这推动了对先进工艺分析技术（PAT）的需求。在线分析具有显著优势，而拉曼光谱作为一种成熟可靠的分析工具已在众多应用中得到验证，可从中测定多种性质。我们最近[Koronaki等人，AIChEJ 2024]曾提出通过将扩散映射（Diffusion Maps，一种流形学习方法）与Y形保形自编码器神经网络相结合，从拉曼光谱数据测定聚合物颗粒尺寸。在本文中，我们将该工作流程扩展至液体浓度预测，并且允许从同一模型进行多目标预测。我们将这些方法应用于两个包含拉曼测量与浓度测量的数据集：一个来自微凝胶聚合过程，另一个来自柠檬酸解离过程。对于单目标浓度预测（即每次由一个模型确定一个目标变量）的结果……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将扩散映射流形学习方法与Y形保形自编码器神经网络相结合，实现了从拉曼光谱数据预测液体浓度，并支持单一模型进行多目标预测，在微凝胶聚合和柠檬酸解离两个数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
